data.name: Unavoidable Swarm
data.description: As a swift action, you can activate a swarm mentality in your collective, and until the end of your next turn, any time a member of your collective is flanking a target, that collective member gains a bonus on his attack rolls against that creature of 1 + the number of collective members flanking that creature instead of the standard +2 bonus for flanking.  You can use this ability %1/day.|UnavoidableSwarmTimes
